title: Trace-conditioned assembly edits with one validity correction
hypothesis: Successful expert placement traces let an edit of the recoverable assembly parent seat the nut, once the edit is allowed the pipeline's standard single validity correction (D-025's trace edits failed only on gate_not_a_lever).

prediction.against: summary-only edits of the same parent in the same blocks, also allowed one validity correction, under identical 24-candidate search
prediction.rationale: Same design as R-029 with one correction per edit (the standard allowance) and more demonstration handoffs so that several successful continuations are available.

code_changes: scripts/compare_generation_modes.py (trace-edit-suite: --allow-correction (one validity correction per edit) and --demo-cases)

falsified_by: Zero success in both trace blocks among valid edits, or a fixed-pair interval upper bound below +0.20; an interval containing zero is inconclusive about an advantage. Invalid edits after the correction still score zero (intention to treat).

cost_estimate.breakdown: 10 demo handoffs + 2 blocks x 2 edits x (24 x 5 probe + 30 promotion) = 610; 4 edits + <= 4 corrections

open_question_refs: D-025 (R-029): trace edits untested because of gate_not_a_lever with no correction
